summary: The subtraction-based flag_bytes implementation allows borrows across byte boundaries to flag nonmatching bytes, causing incorrect line-break counts and byte-to-line indices. The fix computes exact per-byte zero flags using bitwise operations. Reverse only this correction. The fix adds pt_byte_to_line_idx in tests/quickcheck_tests.rs, which compares line indices against a slower reference implementation on generated newline sequences. Both selected source regions occur exactly once. No builds or tests were run.
